item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 09/Jun/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers to the coast of southern China today. Meanwhile, a southerly airstream will affect the region gradually. With the trough of low pressure moving inland and the anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather will be brighter and hot over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, showers will increase with thunderstorms over the coast of southern China later this week.

Temp range: 26 - 30 C
